messages:
Alex (AE): Kicking off POC scoping for AcmeCorp proof-of-value. Need alignment on top 3 use cases, success criteria, and blockers this week. cc @Priya @Jordan @Lena

Priya (Solutions SE): Thanks — can we confirm endpoints you want us to exercise? chat/generate/embeddings/rerank?

Lena (Customer PM): Priority is: 1) Support agent (chat + retrieval), 2) Summaries for transcripts (generate), 3) Candidate ranking for responses (rerank). Embeddings are optional for week2.

Jordan (Sales Eng): Suggested MVP endpoints: /v1/chat (retrieval augmented), /v1/summarize, /v1/rerank. Will test latency <= 300ms p50 and throughput ~50 req/s per endpoint.

Priya (Solutions SE): Agreed. For acceptance, propose: accuracy > 85% on 200 eval queries, summary conciseness score >= 4/5, hallucination rate < 5% on curated set.

Miguel (Prospect CTO): Those metrics look OK. Also need data residency in EU and audit logs + KMS. What are the hosting options and cost delta for dedicated vs hosted?

Alex (AE): Hosted API: pay-as-you-go. Dedicated: monthly reserved capacity (cheaper per-token, SLA-backed). I'll send a placeholder pricing delta after we size expected token volume. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

Tara (Security): We'll need the security questionnaire answered before week2. Also ask if Redwood supports customer-managed keys (KMS), SOC2 Type II, and network allowlist. HIPAA is a maybe.

Priya (Solutions SE): We can provide SOC2 + KMS options; private deployment possible for HIPAA. I'll drop the security checklist link and a prefilled draft.

Priya (Solutions SE): https://redwood.example.com/security-checklist (prefilled answers attached)

Lena (Customer PM): Timeline proposal: 4 weeks. Week1: integration + sample prompts; Week2: eval run (200 queries) + security review; Week3: tuning + cost/perf recs; Week4: go/no-go + handoff.

Jordan (Sales Eng): For eval harness we'll use their 200 labeled queries + 100 unseen. I’ll run an automated suite that measures latency, token cost, and accuracy. Sample cURL we run:

Jordan (Sales Eng): ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"inputs":"<prompt>","max_tokens":256}'
```

Miguel (Prospect CTO): Can you include an endpoint-level budget cap? We want a hard stop after $5000 POC spend unless approved.

Alex (AE): Noted — we'll set spend cap and alerting. Also would like a short success checklist for the customer success team: 1) 85% task accuracy, 2) latency targets met, 3) security sign-off, 4) pricing acceptance.

Priya (Solutions SE): Action items: Priya to send security answers + deployment options; Jordan to share eval harness and sample report; Alex to send draft pricing and contract language; Lena to share prompt bank and acceptance labels.

Lena (Customer PM): Sharing prompt bank by EOD. Also include edge cases (ambiguous queries) for hallucination tests.

Tara (Security): I'll review security answers by Thu and flag anything blocking. For KMS we need key rollover docs.

Alex (AE): Great — can we target Monday kickoff? If so I’ll block weekly check-ins + add the dev slack channel. :calendar: 

Miguel (Prospect CTO): Monday works. Thanks everyone.

DevBot (deploy-bot): Reminder: internal checklist template created: /playbooks/poc-templates/enterprise-checklist

Alex (AE): Thanks — closing this thread. Will post kickoff invite.
